senses.definition: n.pr.loc. Μνήματα (τῆς) ἐπιθυμίας: a station in wilderness (the graves of desire, cf. Nu 11:34 and תַּאֲוָה p. 16 supr.);—Nu 11:34, 35, קִבְרֹת הַתּ׳ 33:16, 17 Dt 9:22.
